'''Bright Tuash''' was a legendary figure in the religion of the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Bright Tuash had [[Bird/Legends|avian]] characteristics and was an ally of [[Adari Vaal]], who was herself revered as the Herald. When the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] made first contact with the Keshiri of the continent [[Alanciar]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] leader, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Varner Hilts]], wore an avian costume and claimed to be Bright Tuash.
